This summary, while it does use only nouns and adjectives, does not strictly adhere to the user's request as it includes verb forms ("awakens").

Assistant B's summary is "Time-traveling protagonist. Confusion and disorientation. Unleashing of powers." This summary strictly adheres to the user's request, using only nouns and adjectives and no verbs or verb forms.
